events.subtitle: Music for 18 Musicians & Canto Ostinato — Performance + Spatial Audio Installation
events.category: Solo multi-instrumental performance / spatial audio installation / anniversary context
events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents Erik Hall on September 26, 2026 at 7:30 PM in a solo performance and spatial-audio installation built around his reinterpretations of Steve Reich's Music for 18 Musicians and Simeon ten Holt's Canto Ostinato. The event marks the 50th anniversary of the New York City premiere of Music for 18 Musicians and Reich's 90th birthday, and is Hall's National Sawdust debut. For Music for 18 Musicians, Hall uses National Sawdust's immersive Meyer Sound system for his one-person multi-tracked arrangement. For Canto Ostinato, the venue says this occasion uniquely draws on Hall's 2026 chamber-orchestra recording with Metropolis Ensemble and Sandbox Percussion while he performs live elements in the room.

en.why_it_matters: Hall is not simply replaying a successful record: the 50th anniversary of Music for 18 Musicians' New York premiere and Reich's 90th birthday become the frame for a one-person, multi-tracked reinterpretation rebuilt for National Sawdust's immersive sound system. Pairing that with a Canto Ostinato treatment that draws on Hall's new chamber-orchestra recording makes the room itself part of the performance and gives this date a concrete reason to make space for it.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is in play that weekend, make room for this Brooklyn night and let the spatial presentation be the reason to choose the live version over simply revisiting the recordings. I would fold it into a New York trip rather than make the corridor journey depend on this date alone.

es.why_it_matters: Hall no viene simplemente a reproducir un disco exitoso: el 50 aniversario del estreno neoyorquino de Music for 18 Musicians y los 90 años de Reich sirven de marco para una reinterpretación unipersonal y multicapa reconstruida para el sistema inmersivo de National Sawdust. Al sumarle un Canto Ostinato que incorpora material de su nueva grabación orquestal, la sala se vuelve parte del argumento musical y la fecha adquiere una razón concreta para abrirle espacio.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York está en juego ese fin de semana, le haría espacio a esta noche en Brooklyn y escogería la experiencia en vivo precisamente por el tratamiento espacial. La integraría a un viaje a Nueva York en vez de hacer depender todo el trayecto por el corredor de esta sola fecha.

events.factual_description: National Sawdust presents inti figgis-vizueta's Music for Transitions on December 11, 2026 at 7:30 PM with cellist Andrew Yee and the Rothko String Quartet. The venue describes the concert as the culmination of more than six years of simultaneous collaborations among figgis-vizueta, Yee and the quartet, who collectively have premiered more than fifteen of the composer's works in the United States and Germany. The program celebrates figgis-vizueta's 2026 debut album Music for Transitions and marks New York premieres of Secret Music, Music for Transitions, Samara and Stolen rivers; additional works remain to be announced.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is the accumulated language of a six-year collaboration, not a generic new-music bill. Yee and the Rothko String Quartet have already carried more than fifteen figgis-vizueta premieres across the U.S. and Germany; here that relationship is concentrated into the release of Music for Transitions, four New York premieres and a string-quintet setting shaped by group improvisation and constant transformation.
en.trip_verdict: Attend if a December New York trip already makes sense, especially if National Sawdust can share the weekend with another strong reason to be in the city. The collaboration is distinctive enough for RADAR, but I would not build the entire corridor trip around this performance alone.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo está en el lenguaje acumulado durante seis años de colaboración, no en una cartelera genérica de música nueva. Yee y el Rothko String Quartet ya han llevado más de quince estrenos de figgis-vizueta por Estados Unidos y Alemania; aquí esa relación se concentra en la salida de Music for Transitions, cuatro estrenos neoyorquinos y un formato de quinteto de cuerdas atravesado por improvisación colectiva y transformación constante.
es.trip_verdict: Iría si un viaje a Nueva York en diciembre ya tiene sentido, sobre todo si National Sawdust puede compartir el fin de semana con otra razón fuerte para estar en la ciudad. La colaboración tiene identidad suficiente para el RADAR, pero no armaría todo el trayecto por el corredor alrededor de esta función por sí sola.
